s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic abdominal pain with weight loss and gastrointestinal bleeding
key_facts: Abdomen was soft and nontender without organomegaly
Normocytic anemia with a hemoglobin level of 11.6 g/dL
Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed a 1.5 cm semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic abdominal pain with weight loss and gastrointestinal bleeding
key_facts: Abdomen was soft and nontender without organomegaly
Normocytic anemia with a hemoglobin level of 11.6 g/dL

shortlist.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Unintentional weight loss and gastrointestinal bleeding

shortlist.label: Gastric polyps
shortlist.why_kept: Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed a 1.5 cm semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body

shortlist.label: Peptic ulcer disease
shortlist.why_kept: Intermittent melena and epigastric abdominal pain

shortlist.label: Gastritis
shortlist.why_kept: Epigastric abdominal pain and normocytic anemia

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy findings and gastrointestinal bleeding

shortlist.label: Gastric lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Unintentional weight loss and gastrointestinal bleeding

shortlist.label: Celiac disease
shortlist.why_kept: History of diet-controlled gluten intolerance and gastrointestinal symptoms

shortlist.label: Familial adenomatous polyposis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of multiple small sessile polyps

raw.rationale: The presence of a 1.5 cm semipedunculated polyp in the gastric body, as revealed by upper gastrointestinal endoscopy, is a key finding that supports this diagnosis, especially given the patient's symptoms of epigastric abdominal pain, unintentional weight loss, and intermittent melena.

rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: While possible, the lack of ulcerations or depressions in the polyp and the absence of other alarming features make this less likely.

rejected.label: Peptic ulcer disease
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and the presence of a polyp rather than an ulcer make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Gastritis
rejected.why: Gastritis would not typically cause the significant weight loss or the specific finding of a polyp.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: The description of the polyp does not suggest the characteristics of a gastrointestinal stromal tumor.

rejected.label: Gastric lymphoma
rejected.why: There is no indication of lymphoma, such as systemic symptoms or specific endoscopic findings suggestive of lymphoma.

rejected.label: Celiac disease
rejected.why: The patient has diet-controlled gluten intolerance, but the presence of a gastric polyp and the specific symptoms do not align with celiac disease.

rejected.label: Familial adenomatous polyposis
rejected.why: There is no mention of multiple adenomatous polyps or a family history that would suggest this condition.

rejected.label: Gastric adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The polyp was completely resected and described without features highly suggestive of malignancy
